description: Application cleared scrutiny and is queued for physical / hybrid Expert Visit Committee inspection. EVC Coordinator assigns inspection date and 3-member expert panel.
aphClauseCitation: APH 2024-2027 Chapter I Cl. 1.9 & Chapter II Table 2.3

entryPrerequisites.description: Case must have cleared SCRUTINY, RE_SCRUTINY, or received a surprise EVC order from SHC.

validationRules: Inspection date must be in the future (minimum 3 days notice to institution)
Minimum 3 qualified experts assigned (Chairman, Subject Expert, Architect/Council Nominee)
Assigned members must have completed no-conflict-of-interest declarations
Inspection mode must be specified (PHYSICAL or HYBRID)

timePolicy.description: EVC Scheduling SLA: Coordinator must schedule date and roster within 7 calendar days of queue entry.

exitConditions.description: EVC event record created with scheduled_at, mode, location_or_link, and 3 committee_assignments.
